To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the performance of competing firms decreases in the performance of the'scandal firms'".

(1) executives of competing firms earned lower compensation when the "scandal firms'" performance was better than their own; (2) the earnings management by competing firms increased when their performance was worse than the "scandal" firm's performance.
The compensation earned by executives at competing firms decreased as the performance of scandal firms increased.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how investors, analysts, and other market participants respond to the accounting fraud perpetrated by the high profile firms.
the impact of accounting scandals on the performance and compensation of competing firms.
how the actions of a few firms affect the actions of many firms.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
Scandals have a chilling effect on the market.
the performance of scandal firms has negative consequences on the performance and the management of competing firms.
the performance of the scandal firms is negatively related to the compensation paid by competing firms and positively related to the level of earnings management by competing firms.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
scandal firms' negative impact is not limited to the firms involved in the scandals but also affects the performance of competing firms".
the performance of scandal firms has negative consequences on the performance of competing firms.
the performance of high profile "scandal" firms negatively affected the compensation and earnings management practices of competing firms.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of the scandal firms has an effect on other firms, and that the performance of competing firms is negatively related to the performance of the scandals firms.
the "scandal firms", which were punished severely by the markets, also had negative consequences on other firms.
the performance of the scandal firm is a benchmark for the performance of competing firms.
